entities.name: LADN indication
entities.description: Information element included by the UE when it needs to request LADN information for specific LADN DNN(s) or to indicate a request for LADN information.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that includes the LADN indication information element when requesting LADN information.

entities.name: LADN DNN
entities.description: Data Network Name associated with a Local Area Data Network for which the UE requests information.

relations.description: UE includes the LADN indication IE when it needs to request LADN information.
LADN indication IE is used to request information for specific LADN DNN(s).
